message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine criminal charge(s) based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: Prison guard (李某) assaulted inmate causing light injury (second-degree). He used fists, causing nasal bone fracture. He reported, confessed, victim forgave, compensated. Likely crime: "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury). Since injury is light (二级轻伤), still intentional injury. Could be "非法拘禁"? He also helped to restrain and move inmate, but that was part of official duty? He was a police officer (民警) but used excessive force. The act of pulling to balcony and beating is beyond lawful use of force. So main charge: intentional injury. Possibly "虐待罪"? In prison context, "虐待罪" applies to persons in custody? Chinese law: "虐待罪" (Article 260) for abusing prisoners, causing injury. But typical charge for beating a prisoner is "故意伤害罪". Also "滥用职权" maybe? But the question likely expects "故意伤害罪". Provide single charge.

Thus answer format: [罪名]故意伤害罪<eoa>
